title: Settling the Folio of a Resort Lodging Reservation
content:
Where the folio of a Resort Lodging reservation falls to be settled, the household itself settles it. A payment entry for the amount the household settles is written to that reservation's folio against the payment route named, and the reservation's outstanding folio balance falls by that amount. The household sees the payment line on the folio and the amount still to be collected on the reservation come down by what they paid, with the money taken from the route they named.

Where the folio was not settled before the party left the mountain, it is settled when the household next takes it up, on the same basis.

## Whose act it is

The act is the household's own, not the desk's. The tool `settle_departure_folio_07fd1088` is unlocked and handed over, and the customer themselves runs it; the reference number of the reservation is read from the record the desk has on screen and given to the household.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `lodging_id` | the reference number identifying the Resort Lodging reservation whose folio the household settles; it is read from the reservation record the desk has on screen and given to the household |
| `settlement_amount_usd` | the amount the household settles, in USD, as a decimal amount rounded to 2 decimal places; a value carrying more decimals is taken rounded to the cent |
| `payment_method` | where the money is taken from |

The value of `payment_method` is one of exactly these: `card_on_file`, used where it is taken from the card the household already has registered with the collective; `card_at_desk`, used where the household presents a card in person; `bank_transfer`, used where the household sends the money from their bank; `lodging_credit`, used where the household spends lodging credit it already holds; `travel_partner`, used where a travel partner settles on the household's behalf; and `none`, which records no money route at all and is reserved for folio entries that move no money.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence on success, carrying the reference number of the folio entry created, the amount in USD settled, the route the money was taken from and the amount left on the folio afterwards. Receiving that sentence, with a folio entry reference in it, is what indicates the payment has been written.
